name: doobers-r11
note: Pass 1 of the emoji audit (docs/art/emoji-audit.md, owner 2026-11-07): story items and currencies. Keys may lie on the diagonal (owner); the Mirror Key is a charm, not a key; Hope has two candidates (dove / lantern) for the owner to pick. story-c (owner feedback): Gold Pass as a golden ticket (two candidates), the Tent in red canvas, the dove re-drawn without the glow that keyed as a halo.

story-a.prompt: CONTROL: the first attached sheet on magenta is this game's APPROVED doober set: match its rendering, outline weight, simplicity, daylight, colours and item size within the cell EXACTLY, so every sheet is one set. CAMERA, NOT negotiable and the same as every other piece of this game's art: each item is seen STRAIGHT FROM THE FRONT, flat-on, as if it stood on a shelf at eye level facing the viewer, its front face parallel to the picture plane; NO three-quarter turn, NO top-down tilt, NO perspective, NO foreshortened top faces; round things are circles, flat things are flat to the viewer, symmetrical things are drawn symmetrically. Only where a pure front view would hide what the thing is may it be tipped the smallest amount needed, never more. SUBJECTS, nine items in order on the 3 x 3 grid, left to right then top to bottom, each straight from the front, and EVERY item kept well inside its own cell with clear magenta margin on all sides, never touching a grid line: EXCEPTION for this sheet only: the four KEYS (items 1 to 4) lie on the DIAGONAL, bow at upper left and bit at lower right, like the classic key glyph; everything else stays straight on. 1 GOLDEN KEY: a slim ornate gold key on the diagonal, a round bow with a small flourish, warm gold. 2 SKELETON KEY: an old iron skeleton key on the diagonal, a simple oval bow, dark grey iron, a little worn. 3 TOWN KEY: a sturdy brass key on the diagonal, its bow shaped like a small town gate arch, brass. 4 DUNGEON KEY: a heavy black iron key on the diagonal, a bow with a skull-like notch, rusted edges. 5 MIRROR KEY: NOT a key: a small oval hand-mirror charm hanging from a short chain, seen straight from the front, silver frame, the glass a soft swirl of violet light with a faint glow, magical. 6 HECATE'S TORCH: a short dark wooden torch standing upright, seen from the front, a bright green-white witch flame with a faint glow. 7 YELLOW HEART: one plump glossy heart flat to the viewer, warm yellow, a small highlight. 8 GREEN HEART: the same heart in leaf green. 9 PURPLE HEART: the same heart in royal purple.
